main_text.p: At non pro corpore naturali & patibili.
1. Sic enim edi non posset nisi dentibus: à qua manducatione ipse Christus avocat Iohann. 6. Caro non prodest quicquam,
2. Et sic discipuli aliter edissent quàm nos: tum enim nondum erat in cruce Caesus.
3. Quomodo potuisset corporaliter edi, qui in cruce corporaliter debebat extendi?
1. quia sic discipuli aliter edissent quam nos.
Nec pro corpore mystico, quod est Ecclesia:

Tandem vigesimâ tertiâ Octobris Zwinglius respondet epistolæ Joannis Bugenhagii. Docet autem: sententiam suam de cœna novam non esse, sed fuisse Christi, Apostolorum, Patrum. Scriptores cùm tropis utantur, non addere Commentarium, quo tropos exponant: se vidisse quidem, tropum inesse verbis cœnæ, sed in qua voce, non vidisse, donec epistolam Batavi cuiusdam legerit: Dictum Christi, Caro non prodest quicquam, non loqui de carnali intelligentia: quia contextus aliud urgeat, & qui statuit, carnem prodesse, is duas salutis vias statuat;Exstat responsio Tom 2 operum Zvvinglii.

page.notes: The marginal note at the right reads "Exstat responsio Tom 2 operum Zvvinglii." (printed in small type across five lines, with a hyphen after "re-"). Some words of the text are damaged by specks and show-through; the reading "Zwinglius" in the main text is printed as "Zwinglius" and "Zwin-" hyphenated at the line end. The printed "Zwin-glius" and "Ecclesia" line-break hyphens are kept as printed. The signature "Q 3" appears at the foot below the last line.
